g.id: 01 / A basket of hollow rolls / print

path.id: A Taiyuan staple made from oat flour. Thin sheets are rolled into open tubes, stood upright and steamed together.
Also known as Youmian Wowo / Oat-flour Nests. A grain, a hand movement, a repeated hollow form.
Hardy oats suit the dry mountain environment of northern Taiyuan. Hand shaping turns a simple grain into a distinctive household staple.
Served with tomato sauce, lamb broth or a vinegar-based dip, the rolls belong to everyday meals and shared celebrations.
